name: Almighty Imperial Gangsters
description: The Almighty Imperial Gangsters are a Puerto Rican Folk Nation street gang founded around 1970 in the Logan Square neighborhood of Chicago. Originally known as the Imperial Spanish Gangsters, they adopted black and pink as their colors and use a crown symbol tied to the Imperial Margarine brand. They were part of the United Latino Organization (1978–1992) alongside the Latin Disciples, Spanish Cobras, and Latin Eagles, and co-founded the Almighty Folks Familia alliance with the Latin Eagles and Simon City Royals in the mid-1990s.
